subject.title: feat: a best-in-class Usage & Spend dashboard — model/tool views, accurate spend, token activity heatmap

question: Should CodexBar accept this broad model/tool/billing dashboard as one maintained product surface after the remaining correctness fixes, or should the work be narrowed to the agreed model-centric scope from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2257?
rationale: The PR changes the information architecture, attribution semantics, and user-facing presentation across many providers; correctness fixes alone cannot determine the intended long-term scope and ownership of that dashboard.

options.title: Sponsor the dashboard scope
options.body: Keep the integrated model, tool, billing, and heatmap experience, but require the listed correctness fixes and focused upgrade-safe validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow to model history
options.body: Retain the model-centric dashboard work and defer billing attribution, extra scanners, or heatmap expansion to separately reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause pending design decision
options.body: Hold the PR until the product discussion defines the supported grouping and attribution contract for cross-provider usage.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the dashboard scope
recommendation.body: Keep the integrated model, tool, billing, and heatmap experience, but require the listed correctness fixes and focused upgrade-safe validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available routing candidate for the unresolved Scope B product decision in the linked feature discussion.
